blocks.text: Yeh chapter 29 (Spectroscopy) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ka sahi jawab wajah ke saath diya gaya hai; short, constructed aur descriptive sawalon ke model jawab hain. Spectrum aur structure wale sawalon mein tasveer ki jagah us ka bayan likha gaya hai. Kitab mein MCQs ki answer key nahi chhapi.
Q1. Multiple Choice Questions (sahi jawab chunein)

blocks.prompt:
I) Which of the following compounds could produce the IR spectrum shown below?
(IR spectrum printed: transmittance (%) from 0 to 100 against wavenumber (cm⁻¹) from 4000 to 500. A very broad, deep band centred near 3400 cm⁻¹; a pair of sharp bands near 2950–2900 cm⁻¹ marked X; a very strong, sharp band near 1710 cm⁻¹ marked Y; several bands below 1500 cm⁻¹.)
(Neeche diya gaya IR spectrum kaun sa compound de sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Spectrum mein do cheezein hain (Table 29.2):
3400 cm⁻¹ ke qareeb chaura band (3200–3600): alcohol ka O–H, carboxylic acid ka bohat chaura 2500–3300 wala band nahi.
1710 cm⁻¹ ke qareeb tez, patla band (1670–1740): carbonyl ka C=O.
Sirf 4-hydroxybutanone, HOCH₂CH₂COCH₃, mein alcohol O–H aur C=O dono hain. Pentan-1-ol aur 2-hydroxybut-1-ene mein C=O nahi; propanoic acid 2500–3300 cm⁻¹ ka zyada chaura O–H band deta.

blocks.prompt:
II) What is the wavelength range of the UV spectrum?
(UV spectrum ki wavelength range kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: UV-Vis spectroscopy electronic energy levels ki tabdeeli dekhne ke liye 200 se 800 nm ki wavelengths istemal karti hai (29.4).

blocks.prompt:
III) The λ of σ to σ* transitions lies in the
(σ se σ* transition ki λ kis region mein hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: σ bonding orbital sab se neeche aur σ* sab se ooper hai, is liye σ→σ* ko sab se zyada energy, yani sab se chhoti wavelength chahiye. Yeh UV region mein hai (asal mein 200 nm se kam, far UV, is liye aam UV-Vis instrument ise record nahi karta).

blocks.prompt:
IV) The types of transitions possible in UV-visible region for a compound with molecular formula C₂H₄ are:
(C₂H₄ wale compound mein UV-visible region mein kaun se transitions mumkin hain?)
blocks.explanation: C₂H₄ ethene, CH₂=CH₂, hai: is mein σ aur π electrons hain, n (non-bonding) electrons nahi, is liye n→π* aur n→σ* mumkin nahi. σ→σ* ko bohat zyada energy chahiye (200 nm se kam). UV-visible range mein π→π* transition hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
V) What is index of hydrogen deficiency of C₈H₈?
(C₈H₈ ka index of hydrogen deficiency kya hai?)
blocks.explanation:
8 C wala saturated alkane: C₈H₁₈ (CₙH₂ₙ₊₂)
Kam hydrogens = 18 − 8 = 10
IHD = 10 / 2 = 5
Koi option 5 nahi (Kitab ki ghalti dekhein). (d) 4 sab se qareeb ke tor par chuna gaya; yeh C₈H₁₀ ke liye durust hota.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Koi option durust nahi: C₈H₈ (maslan styrene, benzene ring + aik C=C) ka IHD = (18 − 8)/2 = 5 hai. (d) 4 sab se qareeb hone ki wajah se chuna gaya; yeh C₈H₁₀ (maslan ethylbenzene) ke liye durust hota.

blocks.prompt:
VI) Which of the following statements about the mass spectrum of CH₃Cl is correct?
(CH₃Cl ke mass spectrum ke bare mein kaun sa bayan durust hai?)

options.text: There is one peak for the molecular ion with an m/e value of 45.
There is one peak for the molecular ion with an m/e value of 52.
The last two peaks have abundances in the ratio 1:1 and occur at m/e values of 50 and 52.
The last two peaks are of equal size and occur at m/e values of 50 and 52.

blocks.explanation:
CH₃³⁵Cl: 12 + 3 + 35 = 50 (M⁺ peak)
CH₃³⁷Cl: 12 + 3 + 37 = 52 ([M+2] peak)
Yani do molecular ion peaks, 50 aur 52 par, 3:1 ki nisbat mein (³⁵Cl ³⁷Cl se teen guna zyada hai). (c) aur (d) m/e theek batate hain magar nisbat 1:1, jo bromine ki hoti hai; Kitab ki ghalti dekhein.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Koi option poori tarah durust nahi: CH₃Cl ki m/e 50 aur 52 wali do peaks ki nisbat 3:1 hai, 1:1 nahi. (c) aur (d) aik hi baat kehte hain (1:1 = barabar size). (c) ko murad wala jawab maan kar chuna gaya, nisbat 3:1 parh kar.

blocks.prompt:
a) Bromobutane, CH₃CH₂CH₂CH₂Br, can be reacted with hot aqueous sodium hydroxide to prepare butan-1-ol.
CH₃CH₂CH₂CH₂Br + OH⁻ → CH₃CH₂CH₂CH₂OH + Br⁻
Butan-1-ol produced can be analysed by mass spectrometry.
i. Predict the formula of fragment ion which is produced to m/e value of 17.
ii. Predict two other fragment ions that you would expect to see in the mass spectrum of butan-1-ol and state the m/e value of each ion.
Butan-1-ol ke mass spectrum mein: i. m/e 17 wala fragment ion kaun sa hai? ii. Do aur fragment ions aur un ki m/e batayein.
blocks.explanation:
i. m/e 17 = OH⁺ (16 + 1).
ii. C–C bonds tootne se maslan C₂H₅⁺ (m/e 29) aur C₃H₇⁺ (m/e 43); aur bhi: CH₃⁺ (15), CH₂OH⁺ (31), C₄H₉⁺ (57). Molecular ion C₄H₉OH⁺ m/e 74 par hai.

blocks.prompt:
b) Identify the functional groups responsible for the peaks labelled X and Y.
(IR spectrum printed: transmittance (%) from 0 to 100 against wavenumber (cm⁻¹) from 4000 to 500. A very broad, deep band centred near 3400 cm⁻¹; a pair of sharp bands near 2950–2900 cm⁻¹ marked X; a very strong, sharp band near 1710 cm⁻¹ marked Y; several bands below 1500 cm⁻¹.)
X aur Y wali peaks kin functional groups ki wajah se hain?
blocks.explanation:
X (taqreeban 2950–2900 cm⁻¹, range 2850–2950): alkyl (sp³) group ke C–H bonds.
Y (taqreeban 1710 cm⁻¹, tez aur patla, range 1670–1740): carbonyl (ketone) ka C=O.
(3400 cm⁻¹ ke qareeb chaura band alcohol ka O–H hai.)

blocks.prompt:
c) Explain how the two isomers shown in the diagram can be distinguished using IR spectroscopy.
(Diagram: A is cyclopentanone, a five-membered ring with a C=O group; B is a five-membered ring with an OH group at the top carbon and a C=C double bond in the ring at the bottom, i.e. cyclopent-3-en-1-ol. Both are C₅H₈O.)
Diagram ke do isomers (A cyclopentanone, B cyclopent-3-en-1-ol) ko IR se kaise pehchanein?
blocks.explanation:
A (ketone): 1670–1740 cm⁻¹ par tez, patla C=O band; O–H band nahi.
B (alcohol + C=C): 3200–3600 cm⁻¹ par chaura O–H band aur 1500–1680 cm⁻¹ par C=C band; 1700 cm⁻¹ ke qareeb C=O band nahi.

blocks.prompt:
d) The molecular formulas of but-1-ene and but-1,4-diene are given below:
but-1-ene: C₄H₈   but-1,3-diene: C₄H₆
i. Fine out the IHD for both of these compounds.
ii. Compare the UV absorption spectrum of but-1-ene to that of but-1,3-diene by stating the difference in their λₘₐₓ qualitatively.
i. But-1-ene aur buta-1,3-diene ka IHD nikalein. ii. Dono ke UV spectrum mein λₘₐₓ ka farq batayein.
blocks.explanation:
i. Saturated C₄: C₄H₁₀.
but-1-ene C₄H₈: IHD = (10 − 8)/2 = 1 (aik C=C)
buta-1,3-diene C₄H₆: IHD = (10 − 6)/2 = 2 (do C=C)
ii. Buta-1,3-diene mein do conjugated (aapas mein jure, baari baari) C=C hain, is liye π→π* ka faasla kam aur λₘₐₓ lambi (217 nm). But-1-ene mein aik akela C=C, faasla zyada aur λₘₐₓ chhoti (taqreeban 200 nm se kam).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein “but-1,4-diene” chhapa hai, magar formula wali line mein but-1,3-diene, C₄H₆ hai; chaar carbon ki chain mein 1 aur 4 par double bonds nahi ho sakte (durust naam buta-1,3-diene). Hissa i mein “Fine out” chhapa hai, murad “Find out” (maloom karein) hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Conjugation (C=C–C=C, double aur single bonds baari baari) jitni zyada, energy levels ka faasla utna kam, aur λₘₐₓ utni lambi. Har izafi conjugated double bond λₘₐₓ ko taqreeban 30–40 nm barha deta hai.
Q3. Constructed Response Questions (soch kar jawab)

blocks.prompt:
a) Compound X is an atmospheric pollutant emitted from fuel combustion of petrol and diesel vehicles. Compound X is a potent human carcinogen. Analysis of compound X showed the following percentage composition by mass: C, 88.89% and H, 11.1%. Mass spectrometry showed a molecular ion peak at m/e = 54. Compound X reacts with H₂ in the presence of a nickel catalyst in a 1 : 2 molar ratio. Analyse and interpret this information to determine a possible structure for compound X. Show all your working.
Compound X ki composition C 88.89%, H 11.1%, M⁺ = 54, aur yeh H₂ se 1 : 2 mein react karta hai. Is ka mumkina structure nikalein.
blocks.explanation:
Given: C = 88.89 %, H = 11.1 %, M⁺ m/e 54 par (Ar: C = 12, H = 1)
1. 100 g mein moles:
C: 88.89 / 12 = 7.41 mol
H: 11.1 / 1 = 11.1 mol
2. Nisbat: 7.41 / 7.41 = 1 ; 11.1 / 7.41 = 1.50
× 2 → C : H = 2 : 3, empirical formula C₂H₃ (mass 27)
3. n = 54 / 27 = 2, molecular formula C₄H₆
4. IHD = (10 − 6)/2 = 2
5. 1 mol X 2 mol H₂ leta hai, is liye dono unsaturation π bonds hain (ring nahi): do C=C ya aik C≡C.
6. Petrol/diesel ke dhuen ka pollutant aur cancer paida karne wala (carcinogen), C₄H₆ aur do C=C: buta-1,3-diene, CH₂=CH–CH=CH₂.
CH₂=CH–CH=CH₂ + 2H₂ → (Ni) CH₃CH₂CH₂CH₃

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: 1 : 2 molar ratio ka matlab: har molecule do H₂ leta hai, yani do π bonds. Ring H₂ nahi leti, is liye IHD = 2 poora π bonds se aata hai. But-1-yne ya but-2-yne bhi 2H₂ leti hain, magar exhaust ka mashhoor carcinogen buta-1,3-diene hai, is liye 'possible structure' yahi hai.

blocks.prompt:
b) How will you differentiate between the following using the UV visible spectroscopy.
(Structures printed: i) a cyclohexene ring whose ring C=C starts at the carbon that carries a –CH=CH–CH=CH₂ side chain, so three C=C bonds are conjugated; ii) a cyclohexane (saturated) ring carrying the same –CH=CH–CH=CH₂ side chain, so only two C=C bonds are conjugated.)
UV-visible spectroscopy se in do compounds (i aur ii) mein farq kaise karein?
blocks.explanation:
Dono π→π* transition se absorb karte hain, magar conjugation mukhtalif hai:
(i) mein teen conjugated C=C (ring ka C=C + side chain ke do), is liye energy ka faasla kam aur λₘₐₓ lambi.
(ii) mein sirf do conjugated C=C (ring saturated hai), is liye λₘₐₓ chhoti, aam diene ke qareeb.
Har izafi conjugated C=C λₘₐₓ ko taqreeban 30–40 nm barhata hai, is liye (i) (ii) se wazeh tor par lambi wavelength par absorb karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
Q4. Describe various possible electronic transitions in a compound having sigma, pi bonds, and non-bonding electrons.
Sigma, pi bonds aur non-bonding electrons wale compound mein mumkina electronic transitions bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Compound mein teen qism ke electrons ho sakte hain: σ electrons (single bonds), π electrons (multiple bonds, unsaturated compounds) aur n electrons (lone pairs, maslan O, N, halogens par).
Orbitals ki energy: σ (bonding) < π (bonding) < n (non-bonding) < π* (anti-bonding) < σ* (anti-bonding). Bonding aur non-bonding orbitals bhare hote hain; π* aur σ* aam tor par khaali.
Sahi energy ki UV-Vis roshni absorb hone par electron bhare orbital se khaali anti-bonding orbital mein jata hai:
1. σ→σ*: sab se zyada energy, sab se chhoti wavelength (200 nm se kam); har compound mein, maslan alkanes.
2. n→σ*: lone pair ka electron σ* mein; maslan alcohols, amines, alkyl halides.
3. π→π*: C=C, C=O, C≡C wale compounds mein; maslan buta-1,3-diene, λₘₐₓ 217 nm. Conjugation faasla kam kar ke λₘₐₓ barhati hai (butadiene 217, hexatriene 257, octatetraene 290 nm).
4. n→π*: sab se kam energy, sab se lambi wavelength; jahan lone pair π bond ke saath ho, maslan aldehydes aur ketones ka C=O.
(σ→π* aur π→σ* bhi mumkin hain magar kam ahem.)
Energy ki tarteeb: σ→σ* > n→σ* > π→π* > n→π*.
200–800 nm range mein ahem transitions π→π*, n→π* aur n→σ* hain. Har transition aik khaas wavelength ki roshni absorb karta hai; zyada se zyada absorption wali wavelength λₘₐₓ kehlati hai.

blocks.prompt:
Q5. Explain two types of atomic spectrum.
Atomic spectrum ki do qismein bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Atomic spectra tab bante hain jab atoms ke electrons mukarrar (discrete) energy levels ke darmiyan harkat karte hain; yeh dikhate hain ke atom ki energy quantized (tukron mein) hai.
1. Emission spectrum: kam pressure wali gas ko garam kar ke banta hai. Garmi electrons ko ooper ke levels par le jati hai; wapas neeche aate hue woh mukarrar energy ke photons kharij karte hain, E = hν. Har transition aik wavelength deta hai, jo kaale background par chamakdar rangeen line dikhti hai. Maslan hydrogen 410, 434, 486 aur 656 nm par lines deta hai (n = 6, 5, 4, 3 se n = 2 par).
2. Absorption spectrum: safaid roshni ko thandi, kam pressure wali gas mein se guzar kar banta hai. Sirf woh photons absorb hote hain jin ki energy ground state ke electrons ko ooper bhejne ke barabar ho; yeh wavelengths rangeen continuous background par kaali lines dikhti hain.
Absorption spectrum ki kaali lines usi element ke emission spectrum ki chamakdar lines wali wavelengths par hoti hain; aik doosre ka photographic negative jaisa. Har element ka apna alag lines ka pattern (fingerprint) hai, is liye atomic spectra se elements pehchane jaate hain, maslan sodium ki 589 nm wali peeli line.

rows: Kam pressure wali gas garam kar ke
Safaid roshni thandi, kam pressure gas se guzar kar
Excited electrons neeche gir kar photons kharij karte hain
Ground state electrons photons absorb kar ke ooper jaate hain
Kaale background par chamakdar rangeen lines
Rangeen continuous background par kaali lines
Lines absorption lines wali wavelengths par

blocks.prompt:
Q6. How mass spectrometry is used to determine the isotopic mass and average atomic masses of elements? Explain giving an example.
Mass spectrometry se isotopic mass aur average atomic mass kaise nikalte hain? Misal ke saath samjhayein.
blocks.explanation:
Mass spectrometer mein sample ke atoms par tez energy wale electrons barsaye jaate hain; har atom aik electron kho kar positive ion banta hai. Ions apne mass-to-charge ratio (m/e) ke mutabiq alag ho kar detect hote hain, aur spectrum % abundance banam m/e record hota hai.
Isotopic mass: element ka har isotope alag peak deta hai; charge +1 hai, is liye peak ki m/e hi us isotope ka mass hai.
Relative abundance (qudrati mixture mein hissa): har peak ki oonchai us isotope ka hissa batati hai.
Phir average (relative) atomic mass:
Aᵣ = Σ (isotopic mass × % abundance) / 100
Misal, boron: spectrum mein m/e 10 (19.9 %) aur m/e 11 (80.1 %) par peaks.
Aᵣ = [(10 × 19.9) + (11 × 80.1)] / 100
Aᵣ = (199 + 881.1) / 100 = 1080.1 / 100
Aᵣ = 10.80
Isi tarah chlorine (³⁵Cl 75 %, ³⁷Cl 25 %): Aᵣ = [(35 × 75) + (37 × 25)] / 100 = 35.5
